description: Real public capture iti_modicon_test.pcap (191 frames); truth from independent stdlib decoder eval/truth_decoder/decode.py

expect.note: model = SZL 0x0011 idx1 MlfB / CIP product name; firmware = SZL 0x0011 idx7 (V+3 bytes) / CIP revision major.minor(3 digits); serial = SZL 0x001C idx5 / CIP serial (hex, 8 digits); hostname = SZL 0x001C idx2 module name (alias idx1 AS name)

notes: Modicon traffic is FC 0x5A (UMAS / Unity) only, 90 req / 90 resp; no FC43 -> not identifiable (UMAS identity is out of scope).
